        step_heights = [random.uniform(1, 10) for _ in range(num_steps)]
        step_sizes = [length // num_steps] * num_steps
        step_sizes[-1] += length % num_steps  # Distribute remainder
        
        for i, (height, size) in enumerate(zip(step_heights, step_sizes)):
            sequence.extend([height] * size)
            
    elif pattern_type == 'gaussian':
        # Gaussian-like pattern
        center = length // 2
